The '''C/L-82 landspeeder''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] model produced by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was a popular design in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] around [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].

The C/L-82 featured a retro design and could easily be maintained and customized, making it a favorite of young [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The ''[[White Witch]]'', the speeder owned by the famous racers [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] and [[Jord Dusat]], was a modified C/L-82.
